verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM that ships its own AI agents, so letting users connect external MCP servers to those agents is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack never mentions MCP or any way to connect external tool servers. Generic 'API and integration support' and REST APIs are adjacent features and do not show the product consuming MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
